name: Durable Workflows
description: The durable workflow engine: workflow runs survive a crash, a restart, or a machine going to sleep, resuming from where they stopped instead of starting over. The default engine every workflow uses unless another is bound.
tagline: Workflow runs that survive a restart

permission_levels.label: Can view runs
permission_levels.description: See durable workflow runs and their history.

permission_levels.label: Can run
permission_levels.description: Start a durable workflow and resume a suspended one.
